choices: It does not compile - n is not returned
explanation: Java copies the argument into the parameter, so n starts as 5 and assigning to it changes only the method's own copy. The caller's variable is untouched. Passing an object is the same rule applied to a reference: reassigning the parameter does nothing to the caller, but changing the object the reference points at does.
